ambiguity_or_context_defects: Referenced Section 1950.6 is absent, but is unnecessary for detecting an assignment.

cases.reason: Owner refers to a person with an ownership interest in the personal property remaining on the premises. This is the same kind of subject as the supplied definition.
actionable_corrections: Retain candidate status; this output does not certify every inclusion or exclusion in the definition.

cases.reason: Reasonably believes is a grammatical variant of reasonable belief. Both concern a person’s knowledge or belief about personal property. The revised task explicitly disclaims establishing the technical investigation conditions, making a candidate connection sufficient.
actionable_corrections: No blocking correction needed. Preserve the candidate-only meaning in all consumers.

cases.reason: Use has no security expression or grammatical variant, and discusses remaining personal property and notice rather than payments, fees, deposits or charges.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: This remains an easy absent-expression negative.
actionable_corrections: Complement with same-expression different-subject and unclear-subject cases.

cases.reason: The introductory clause expressly gives chapter scope and the supplied hierarchy places both definition and use in Chapter 5 of the same instrument and parent units.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: Hierarchy is supplied metadata; textual scope is not proof that chapter application conditions are met.
actionable_corrections: Keep hierarchy provenance and case applicability separate.

cases.reason: The express chapter scope is Chapter 5, while the supplied use location is Chapter 2.
Use_location.unit is null. The request does not establish that the use is in the chapter covered by the definition. Nearby section numbering cannot supply the missing hierarchy.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: Necessary use hierarchy is deliberately withheld.
actionable_corrections: For production, retrieve sourced hierarchy; retain this fixture as a missing-context check.

cases.reason: The supplied definition text defines owner but has no express scope statement. Matching chapter locations cannot establish the reach of a definition without such a statement under this question.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: The source introductory scope clause is withheld from this payload.
actionable_corrections: For production, provide the anchored introductory clause; retain the fixture as an omitted-scope check.

cases.reason: Candidate says the landlord need not comply with paragraph (2) or (3) under specified alternatives, directly changing whether the document requirement must be fulfilled.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: The requirement bundles several document and statement obligations. That does not obstruct this paragraph-level relation.
actionable_corrections: Keep the paragraph-level relation distinct from any later decomposition into individual duties.

cases.reason: Candidate overrides paragraph (4), requires compliance with paragraph (2) after a timely request, and sets a 14-day compliance period.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: Paragraph (1) is absent, but the explicit paragraph (2) relation is sufficient. The new selected-context wording accurately describes the omission.
actionable_corrections: Include paragraph (1) only if a later task needs the complete timeline or identity of the itemized statement.

cases.reason: Candidate sets mailing destinations. It does not change whether the required documents must be furnished or their due time.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: This NO is limited to whether-or-when modification; there remains a delivery relationship.
actionable_corrections: Do not interpret NO as absence of every operational dependency. No destination-specific prompt cue is needed.

cases.reason: Candidate permits estimated charges under specified conditions and expressly requires completion of paragraph (2) within 14 calendar days of repair completion or receipt of documentation.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: The general paragraph (1) deadline is omitted, but the timing modification is express without it.
actionable_corrections: Do not treat this relationship judgment as a complete computed deadline.

cases.reason: The use describes ownership of residential rental properties and dwelling units. The definition concerns interests in personal property. Thus even treating owns as a grammatical variant of owner does not produce the same kind of subject.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: Grammatical variant is not formally defined across noun-to-verb derivations. This does not affect NO here because the object differs independently.
A NO could still arise from an overly strict exact-expression matcher, so the fixture alone cannot prove semantic disambiguation.
actionable_corrections: Add a paired same-subject positive using owns, or an exact-owner different-subject negative, to isolate semantic from morphological performance.

cases.reason: As defined in subdivision (a) of Section 1962 explicitly adopts a definition by reference, which the question expressly includes.
ambiguity_or_context_defects: Target text is absent; that prevents interpreting the imported definition but not detecting adoption.
The phrase may leave the exact syntactic attachment of landlord or his agent open; existence of at least one adoption remains clear.
actionable_corrections: Do not require target text for presence detection. Test target interpretation separately.

cases.reason: The focus contains no explicit reference to another provision or enclosing legal unit. Lease or agreement identifies a contract, not a specified legal provision in this passage.

ambiguity_or_context_defects: There can be a consequence or enforcement relationship without a whether-or-when qualification.
actionable_corrections: Preserve the narrow output type and evaluate consequence relationships in a separate task.
